---
title: "Practice exercises: your first map and projections"
---

The exercises below run in your browser and check your code automatically, giving you feedback as you go. They practise everything from [Your first map](43_first-map.qmd) and [Map projections](44_projections.qmd): filtering, filling, zooming, highlighting and projections. There's also some `mutate()` practice: normalising population by area, to compare how crowded countries are, not just how big they are. Next class picks this up for choropleth maps.

The map exercises are checked by comparing your **code** to a model solution, and the `mutate()` exercises by comparing your **result**. The last two are a bit more of a challenge. The map data takes a few seconds to load the first time.
